root_cause.text: The IMA subsystem accesses the `hash_algo_name` array using the index `HASH_ALGO__LAST` when creating securityfs files for unsupported TPM hash algorithms, leading to a global out-of-bounds read.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff in `security/integrity/ima/ima_fs.c` adds a check `if (algo == HASH_ALGO__LAST)` to prevent indexing `hash_algo_name[algo]` and instead uses the raw `alg_id` to format the file name.

intent_record.intent_summary: Handle unmapped TPM algorithms by naming securityfs measurement files with their TPM algorithm ID when the algorithm is HASH_ALGO__LAST.
intent_record.what: Added conditional checks to determine if the hash algorithm is HASH_ALGO__LAST, formatting the securityfs file name with the TPM bank's algorithm ID in hex if true, and falling back to the standard hash algorithm name otherwise.
intent_record.how: Prevents potential out-of-bounds array accesses on hash_algo_name when dealing with unsupported or unmapped TPM algorithms, enabling the creation of securityfs measurement files named after the raw TPM algorithm ID.
